findings.title: Scorable-session caption counts tapered sessions; Visits/Energy/Last visit describe only model-admitted history
findings.mechanism: usable increments after location/time/energy/duration admission but before tapered sessions are removed from clean. The metric calls usableSessions scorable; ratedSessions is clean.length. Site.sessions, totalEnergyWh and lastSeen derive from admitted metrics, not every returned visit. Dropped observations are not disclosed by these fact labels.
findings.repro: Source-only hypothetical input: one named site with four valid untapered sessions, one valid 85%-95% tapered session, one short session and one session without location. totalSessions=7, usableSessions=5, site.sessions=5, ratedSessions=4. Caption says 5 scorable sessions even though only 4 can score; Visits shows 5, not 7. No fixture executed.
findings.fix: An exclusively authorized followup should label model-admitted versus clean/scorable denominators and disclose excluded history; preserve specialist filters, original query and raw measurements.
findings.disposition: New precise source finding; no matching queued source fix root found; no queue edit.

findings.title: Location cost renders known modeled zero as the same dash as unrated unknown
findings.mechanism: cost tests hoursLostPerYear > 0 and otherwise returns an em dash. The model initializes healthy and unrated sites to zero; the metric band correctly uses benchmark availability to distinguish null from zero, but the location cost ignores that distinction.
findings.repro: Source-only: a rated healthy site has modeled hoursLostPerYear=0, while an unrated site also carries the zero sentinel. Both render Costs you = dash on desktop and all-fields mobile details; the metric band shows numeric zero when judged sites exist. A positive 0.4 estimate rounds to visible 0 h/year, exposing inconsistent zero policy. No runtime executed.
findings.fix: Use evidence eligibility separately from numeric sign; present an explicit modeled-zero/no modeled loss state for rated sites and unknown for unrated sites without claiming actual measured loss.
findings.disposition: New precise source finding; no queue edit.

findings.title: Grouping help promises physical-stall recognition unsupported by the model
findings.mechanism: Help claims the same physical stall is recognised across visits and AC/DC are labelled separately. Actual identity is lowercased place name or a 0.01-degree rounded coordinate cell; there is no stall identifier. A single grouped site gets one kind from any admitted session peak >25kW. The inferred-condition disclaimer is correct but does not make physical identity guarantees true.
findings.repro: Source-only: two distinct stalls sharing start_place=Station A are grouped under place:station a; one AC-like and one DC-like observation produce one group labeled DC. Coordinate-only neighboring stalls can also share one cell. The subtitle says a stall cannot hide despite missing/excluded observations. This is a copy/model contradiction, not evidence any real charger is faulty.
findings.fix: An authorized copy followup should describe approximate location aggregation and inferred class, avoid physical-stall identity/detection guarantees, and retain the explicit session-derived condition disclaimer.
findings.disposition: New precise source-copy finding; no queue edit.

findings.title: Chart accessible fallback exposes raw English status tokens instead of translated labels
findings.mechanism: exportData stringifies status and is also passed as data. Status column supplies no format callback. Shared accessible fallback uses String(raw), displaying healthy/degrading/degraded even though location badges use t(chargerHealth.status.*).
findings.repro: Source-only: one rated degrading site with a non-English UI locale reaches the fallback Status cell as literal degrading. Only the column heading is translated. Same data feed is used for CSV; stable CSV enum policy remains an integration decision. No browser/CSV export executed.
findings.fix: Localize the user-facing accessible status cell at display boundary; explicitly preserve or separately define existing CSV enum semantics, chart scope and ordering.
findings.disposition: New exact i18n path; zero hardcoded-JSX scan is not zero i18n violations.

findings.title: Chart fallback numeric columns bypass locale-aware formatting
findings.mechanism: ratio/baseline/recent columns have neither kind nor format. Shared fallback formats finite numeric values only when col.kind exists; otherwise String(raw) produces locale-independent decimal dots. Locations use preference-aware formatPower. Source W and ratio are not corrupted.
findings.repro: Source-only: ratio=87.5 and baseline=11.1 in a de-DE display preference reach fallback as 87.5 and 11.1 rather than localized comma decimals. Setting a preference does not affect String(raw). No runtime executed.
findings.fix: Use existing ChartContainer display column formatting at render boundary, retaining source W, existing historical kW export values and precision/scope unless the integration owner authorizes a contract change.
findings.disposition: Partly inherited chart fallback/export display-boundary debt from audit-page-079 architectureIssues[2]; attach this exact mechanism to that root, not a duplicate formatting campaign.

findings.title: Last visit ignores saved locale and timezone display options
findings.mechanism: formatDateShort is called without opts. Its Intl locale is undefined and timezone override is absent, so date uses browser defaults, while adjacent power/energy fields consume saved locale through useUnits. No saved timezone/display-mode operand is passed.
findings.repro: Source-only: with saved locale de-DE and browser en-US, Last visit follows browser month labels while power/energy follow saved locale. With a midnight-adjacent UTC session and a configured user timezone differing from the browser, the calendar date can differ. Exact native DateTime policy and browser behavior were not executed.
findings.fix: An authorized followup should reuse existing date/preference ownership for the date operand rather than introduce a new converter; keep the observed history timestamp and query bounds unchanged.
findings.disposition: New precise source preference path; source-only repro, no native confirmation.

candidates.mechanism: Real handler returns domain DTO using startedAt/completedAt/energyAddedWh/battery-level fields and no location; model requires place/coordinates before computing any metric. Inspected camelCaseKeys only adds snake-to-camel aliases, not inverse aliases, location or semantic field renames.

candidates.title: Annualization reliability for tightly clustered or truncated admitted observations
candidates.mechanism: Annual energy uses admitted totalEnergyWh / max(1, first-to-last start-day span) *365, including admitted tapered energy while power baselines use clean sessions. Four observations in one day can project that day to a year. Metric explanation calls it annualized, not measured; observation coverage and sampling reliability are not established.
candidates.reproToValidate: Domain owner should assess dense one-day samples, sparse visits, missing/excluded events and partial returned-history coverage against intended unchanged estimator; no executable fixture or policy assertion run.
candidates.disposition: Candidate only: specialist behavior is frozen, not a proven wrong formula or authorization to rewrite it.

reviewedContracts.healthEvidence: Session energy Wh and duration seconds derive positive mean W; clean high-quantile baseline, last up-to-five clean mean, thresholds .9/.75, four-clean minimum. No nameplate or hardware diagnostic proof; missing/negative/subthreshold energy and bad durations are excluded, not coerced to zero.
reviewedContracts.unknownZero: No payload -> metric null; loaded [] -> truthful tracked-site zero, other benchmark-dependent metrics null; unknown sites use neutral status/dash baseline; recent is shown only with ratedSessions>0. Underperforming and annual-loss zero are known only if at least one judged site. F02 flags row-level inconsistency.
reviewedContracts.SIAndSigns: Specialist keeps Wh/W/s and positive charging energy; negative energy/nonpositive power are rejected, not absolute-valued. Aggregate annual hours are converted to seconds only for shared duration metric. Location power/energy useUnits; chart explicitly preserves historical kW boundary/export operands. Currency cost is not inferred: Costs you is modeled time, not money.
reviewedContracts.scopeAndBounds: Page consumes selected vehicle and useChargingSessions only (page18-27, hook56-64). AbortSignal/vehicle cache identity retained; real /charging-sessions handler registered by router5034. Header route /charger-health is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope23-77) and not vehicle-disabled. Thus no header-owned range is implied/ignored here: frozen observed history has no start/end query bounds, and Stats period is explicitly unknown Returned charging history. No date controls/limits/history-hook substitution added; backend completeness unknown.
reviewedContracts.trust: Single historical query; deriveDataState hasData=data!==undefined, fatal only without retained data, stale on refresh failure or pause (dataState190-254). Page loading excludes fatal/paused; chart receives fatalError only, each shell has source notice; stale keeps metrics/chart/rows and Retry forwards refetch. Paused notice says connect/resume, not proven device offline. No all-page error/empty gate.
reviewedContracts.actions: Source notice retry -> state.retry -> void source.refetch (dataState201-204). Chart receives source retry and existing ChartContainer export/fallback actions; no new device/vehicle mutation. Location table is nonsearchable/nonpaginated/exportable=false, help and shared mobile Quick view remain available in source. No action/export executed.
reviewedContracts.i18n: Page, panel, actions, explanations and location-status strings use t with fallbacks; manual F04 identifies raw chart status path missed by literal JSX scan. Canonical catalog completeness/plural behavior not checked; no catalog modifications.
reviewedContracts.a11yMobile: PageLayout forwards PageContainer route-focus heading and aria-busy; ChartContainer has localized ariaLabel and numeric/status alternative table. Locations uses 3-column card strategy; DataTable allColumns=columns (1408) and mobile modal maps allColumns (148-153), preserving all9 facts despite hidden card metadata.
